attributes.name: Stone Golem
attributes.powers:
The Stone Golem is immune to the Attack and Mental traits.

If undefeated, each character at your location is dealt 1d4-1 Combat damage; do not reset your hand at the end of the turn.

As this ponderous golem inexorably advances, you'll only hear the sound of grinding stone.

corrections.corrected_text: On the monster Carrion Golem, change "You may not play spells that have the Attack trait" to "The Carrion Golem is immune to the Attack and Mental traits". (This card also appears in the Character Add-On Deck.)This also applies to the monsters Warmonger Wasp in adventure deck 3 and Stone Golem and Urannag in adventure deck 4, and the henchman Devastator in adventure deck 6.
corrections.issue: Are golems affected by items that have the Attack trait?
